categories.main_business_segments: Sports Gear Co., Ltd. primarily operates as an OEM manufacturer of footwear products, focusing on sports shoes and casual shoes. The company produces specialized footwear including soccer shoes, American football shoes, jogging, hiking, and general leisure shoes, as well as baseball shoes. It serves major international brand customers and has expanded production facilities across Southeast Asia and Europe.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced manufacturing technologies such as direct injection technology and automated production processes. It invests in smart factory initiatives including IoT simulation, robotic arms, real-time data systems, and cloud computing to enhance production stability, speed, and flexibility. R&D efforts focus on new shoe materials, automation, process improvements, and sustainable, low-carbon footprint technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sports Gear serves internationally renowned brand manufacturers, including major global sports brands referred to as Group A, B, C, and D. Its products are sold primarily in Europe and the Americas, which account for about 80% of revenue, with additional sales in Asia. The company maintains long-term partnerships with these brands, providing customized development and manufacturing services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases mainly in Vietnam and Cambodia, and expanding facilities in Indonesia, Portugal, and Germany. Sales markets are concentrated in Europe and the Americas, with growing presence in Asia. Subsidiaries and branches are located in multiple countries including Samoa, Seychelles, British Virgin Islands, Singapore, Myanmar, and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sports Gear Co., Ltd. operates in the midstream segment of the footwear supply chain as a contract manufacturer (OEM). It procures raw materials from upstream suppliers and manufactures finished footwear products for downstream brand owners and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in direct injection technology, automation, and sustainable manufacturing processes. It has established dedicated R&D centers aligned with major brand customers to co-develop products. Strategic initiatives include digital transformation, smart factory development, energy efficiency, renewable energy adoption, and setting science-based carbon reduction targets through participation in SBTi.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales as an OEM footwear manufacturer supplying international brand customers. The company does not engage in direct retail but earns income from manufacturing contracts and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Sports Gear positions itself as a leading OEM footwear manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities, advanced automation, and sustainable production practices. It holds a significant market share in the global soccer shoe market, accounting for approximately one-fifth of global sales, and maintains competitive advantages through multi-country production and close collaboration with major international brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved consolidated sales of NT$18.44 billion, a 29.8% increase from 2023, with net profit after tax of NT$1.59 billion, nearly doubling year-on-year. The company produced 35.6 million pairs of shoes in 2024, up 19.7% from the previous year. It has a strong financial position with total assets of NT$23.57 billion and equity of NT$15.24 billion, reflecting steady growth and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sports Gear emphasizes high-quality manufacturing aligned with international brand standards, advanced R&D and innovation in footwear technology, and sustainable production practices including low-carbon footprint products. Its multi-country production strategy and smart factory initiatives enable flexibility, cost control, and responsiveness to market trends, providing brand customers with reliable, innovative, and environmentally responsible footwear solutions.
